en.hook: Every joint origin is written in its parent's frame. Read it from the world and I point, very confidently, at the wrong corner.
en.mission: Run `cd code && python3 -c "from main import *; c=chain(parse_urdf(URDF)[1],'base','hand'); print(naive_position(c), link_positions(c,{'shoulder':0,'elbow':0})['hand'])"`. Which hand position is right, and why?
